service: firebase-push-notifications

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: us-east-1
  stage: dev

functions:
  sendNotification:
    handler: index.sendNotification
    events:
      - http:
          path: send-notification
          method: post
          cors: true

  healthCheck:
    handler: index.healthCheck
    events:
      - http:
          path: health-check
          method: get
          cors: true

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

resources:
  Resources:
    FirebaseLambdaExecutionRole:
      Type: AWS::IAM::Role
      Properties:
        AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
        Policies:
          - PolicyName: FirebaseLambdaExecutionPolicy
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - sns:Publish
                    - dynamodb:Query
                    - dynamodb:Scan
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - firestore:Read
                    - firestore:Write
                    - fcm:Send
                  Resource: "*"

custom:
  apiUrls:
    sendNotificationUrl: 'https://${self:provider.stage}.execute-api.${self:provider.region}.amazonaws.com/dev/send-notification'
    healthCheckUrl: 'https://${self:provider.stage}.execute-api.${self:provider.region}.amazonaws.com/dev/health-check'
